subject: CONTENT AUDIT RP10: 15/15 feedback_correct missing -- needs all before publishing
body:
CONTENT AUDIT: retake-practice-10 -- 15/15 feedback_correct missing

From: GD design audit (follow-up to 20260223-0415 feedback gaps report)
To: GR (data owner)

RESULT: RP10 has complete hints (15/15) and feedback_wrong (15/15).
        But feedback_correct is MISSING on ALL 15 questions.

This means: when Kai answers correctly, the result area shows "🔥 Correct!" (generic fallback).
He gets no tailored celebration or skill acknowledgment. MCM voice failure.

WHAT GR NEEDS TO ADD
One feedback_correct string per question. Voice spec:
  - Max 10 words (ideally 5-7)
  - One emoji max (🔥 preferred for correct)
  - Celebrate the RESULT/SKILL, not the effort
  - MCM-voice: direct, specific, coach

Examples from RP1 (the gold standard):
  "🔥 Parent and intercepts nailed."           (Q1 -- identify)
  "🔥 Square both sides. Done."                (Q6 -- radical)
  "🔥 Common base. Smooth."                    (Q7 -- exponential)
  "🔥 Caught the extraneous one."              (Q10 -- extraneous)
  "🔥 24 hours. Exponential growth."           (Q15 -- word-problem)

Pattern: feedback_correct names what Kai just did, not just that he got it right.

ALSO NOTE
RP10 is not yet in manifest.json or index.html (separate P2 filed to GA: 20260223-0425).
GR should complete feedback_correct before GA wires RP10 into the dashboard.
Math accuracy: GD has not verified RP10 answers. GR should self-verify before publishing.

COMPARISON TABLE
  RP1: 15/15 fb_correct, 15/15 fb_wrong -- COMPLETE
  RP2: (not yet audited)
  RP3: (not yet audited)
  RP4: 15/15 fb_correct, 12/15 fb_wrong -- needs 3 fb_wrong
  RP5: 15/15 fb_correct, 13/15 fb_wrong -- needs 2 fb_wrong
  RP6: 15/15 fb_correct, 3/15 fb_wrong -- needs 12 fb_wrong
  RP7: 13/15 fb_correct, 6/15 fb_wrong -- needs 2 fb_correct + 9 fb_wrong
  RP8: (not yet audited)
  RP9: (not yet audited)
  RP10: 0/15 fb_correct, 15/15 fb_wrong -- needs all 15 fb_correct
